headline.en: Venezia have a verbal agreement to sign Toni Fernandez
headline.es: El Venezia tiene un acuerdo verbal por Toni Fernandez

summary.en: Venezia have a verbal deal for Toni Fernandez at about four million euros. Fabrizio Romano reported a 50 percent sell-on clause and a buy-back that Deco wanted in the contract. Fernandez is 18 and entering the last year of his deal. The sale sits with the earlier exits of Hector Fort and Alvaro Cortes. It funds the next first-team registration under the 1:1 rule.
summary.es: El Venezia tiene un acuerdo verbal por Fernandez cerca de cuatro millones. Romano avanzo un 50 por ciento de futura venta y una recompra. Tiene 18 anos. La venta acompana las de Fort y Cortes.

body.en: This is not a first-team story and should not be written as one. Fernandez had Copa and Liga minutes as a teenager and still sits behind a winger group that now includes Yamal, Raphinha, Gordon and Adeyemi. Venezia give him games in a league that will test him every week. Barcelona keep a buy-back and half of a future sale, which is the structure Deco has used on Fort and Cortes. MARCA floated a figure closer to five million. Romano's clauses matter more than the exact headline number until the contract is lodged. The money does not pay for Rodri. It keeps the 1:1 sheet legal so the players Flick actually wants can stay on the list. If Fernandez explodes in Italy, the buy-back is the story in two years. If he does not, the ratio still closed in August. That is the deal. Treat every copy that calls this a collapse of La Masia as noise. The academy is still producing the players Flick has already promoted, including Xavi Espart this week. Selling the ones he will not name is how the club stays inside the rule.

headline.en: Raphinha is setting the height of the press without a centre-forward
headline.es: Raphinha marca la altura de la presion sin un delantero centro

summary.en: Mundo Deportivo described small changes in how Barcelona start the press without a classic centre-forward. Against Elche and Athletic, Raphinha set the height of the line rather than only stretching the wing. That is separate from the Alvarez file. Rayo, who defend deep, will show on Monday whether those distances hold for ninety minutes.
summary.es: Mundo Deportivo describio cambios en la presion sin un delantero centro clasico. Ante Elche y Athletic, Raphinha marco la altura de la linea. El Rayo dira el lunes si esas distancias aguantan.

body.en: The false-nine look is a specific job, not a slogan. Raphinha arrives in the half-spaces when the first line jumps, with Fermin or Pedri joining from midfield. Athletic allowed that because they also tried to play out. Rayo will not. If the distances between Espart or Cancelo and the far winger grow, Barcelona will recycle the ball in front of a packed box and look less like the team that scored seven in two games. Flick can still start Ferran as a closer reference. He has not done that in the first two Liga matches. Monday is the first chance to see whether that is a choice or a habit. Alvarez remains a separate file. Atletico have not opened talks, so writing the press as if a nine is arriving next week is a category error. The useful question is whether Gordon or Adeyemi start on the left to help the first wave, and whether Pedri has to cover Gavi again. Those are selection questions. They decide if the press Flick recovered from his first season survives a low block.

headline.en: Xavi Espart is registered with the first team and will wear number 12
headline.es: Xavi Espart esta inscrito en el primer equipo y llevara el 12

summary.en: Barcelona have registered Xavi Espart as a first-team player with LaLiga and given him the number 12 shirt. He is 19. Flick started him at left-back in Elche after comparing him last year to Philipp Lahm, then used him higher up against Athletic. Cadena SER treated the promotion as the usual August problem at the club: a Masia player forcing his way into the squad list.
summary.es: El Barca ha inscrito a Espart y le ha dado el 12. Tiene 19 anos. Flick lo alineo de lateral zurdo en Elche y lo movio por dentro ante el Athletic.

body.en: Espart wore 36 on the opening weekend and will now wear 12 once the paperwork is complete. He can play both full-back roles and as an interior. That is why Flick preferred him to Hector Fort in the senior group and why Balde's public week did not automatically return him to the eleven. Starting a 19-year-old at left-back in Elche was a statement about trust. The Athletic match showed the other use: Espart stepping inside when a winger held the touchline. Promotion does not guarantee starts after Rayo. It means he is no longer a B-team guest when Flick needs a body. Cadena SER called it the blessed problem Flick gets every August. That is the right frame. Barcelona are selling Fernandez and Cortes in the same week they are promoting Espart. Those two facts belong together. The academy is not being emptied. The players Flick will actually use are being moved onto the first-team sheet, and the ones he will not use are being sold with a string attached.
